definition_en: a person who learns a trade from a skilled employer for a fixed period
core_image: 工坊里的少年：白天递工具、擦长凳，夜里偷偷练手艺
scene: 铁匠铺里炉火通红，老匠人把一把新锉刀放进少年手中。The blacksmith took on an apprentice to pass on his craft.
sceneCN: 这里 apprentice 是「学徒」（第 1 个义项：跟师傅学手艺的人）；句意为：铁匠收了一名学徒来传承手艺。

derivatives.zh: 加名词后缀 -ship，义为「学徒期；学徒身份」
过去分词转形容词，义为「当过学徒的」

senses.title: A learner of a trade
senses.definition: someone bound to work for a master in order to learn a craft
senses.definitionCN: 签约跟随师傅做工以学手艺的人
senses.example: The apprentice swept the shop before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 学徒天亮前就把店铺扫净了。
senses.why: Learning happens by holding, so the learner is taken into the master's hands.
senses.whyCN: 学习靠亲手握持，所以学手艺的人被交到师傅手中。

senses.title: A trainee in a profession
senses.definition: a beginner gaining supervised experience in a modern occupation
senses.definitionCN: 在现代行业里接受指导积累经验的初学者
senses.example: She spent a year as an apprentice electrician.
senses.exampleCN: 她做了一年电工见习生。
senses.why: Old workshop bonds became modern supervised training.
senses.whyCN: 旧式工坊契约演变为现代的带教训练。

senses.title: A beginner without skill
senses.definition: a person with little experience in any activity
senses.definitionCN: 在某种活动中缺乏经验的人
senses.example: In the kitchen I am still an apprentice.
senses.why: Anyone still holding the tools awkwardly is like a bound learner.
senses.whyCN: 握工具还笨拙的人，就像尚未出师的学徒。

senses.title: To bind someone as a learner
senses.definition: to arrange for a person to train under a master
senses.definitionCN: 安排某人到师傅门下受训
senses.example: His father apprenticed him to a printer.
senses.exampleCN: 他父亲送他去印刷匠门下当学徒。
senses.why: The holding works both ways: the master takes hold of the learner.
senses.whyCN: 握持是双向的：师傅也把学徒「握」在门下。

senses.title: To learn by serving
senses.definition: to acquire skill while doing humble work for an expert
senses.definitionCN: 在为行家打杂的过程中习得技能
senses.example: He apprenticed in a Paris bakery for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 他在巴黎一家面包坊学徒两年。
senses.why: Service is the price of the secrets held by the master.
senses.whyCN: 服杂役是换取师傅独门技艺的代价。

senses.title: A member of a guild's junior rank
senses.definition: historically, the lowest rank of a guild, below journeyman and master
senses.definitionCN: 旧时行会中低于熟练工与师傅的最低等级
senses.example: Every guild apprentice hoped to rise to master.
senses.exampleCN: 每个行会学徒都盼着升为师傅。
senses.why: The ladder of holding: first you are held, then you hold the trade.
senses.whyCN: 握持的阶梯：先被师傅握管，再由你握住整门手艺。

senses.title: One under a legal contract
senses.definition: a person bound by a formal indenture specifying duties and years
senses.definitionCN: 受正式契约规定职责与年限约束的人
senses.example: The apprentice signed papers binding him for seven years.
senses.exampleCN: 学徒签署了约束他七年的文书。
senses.why: Legal papers hold both master and learner to the bond.
senses.whyCN: 法律文书把师徒双方都约束在契约之中。

senses.title: An eager follower of a master
senses.definition: figuratively, a devotee learning from someone admired in any field
senses.definitionCN: 比喻在任意领域追随仰慕者学习的人
senses.example: Young poets served as apprentices to the old master's style.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻诗人们模仿老大师的风格学习。
senses.why: Any field with masters can bind learners to them.
senses.whyCN: 凡有大师之处，皆可有门徒相随。

intro.en: Apprentice comes through Old French aprendre, to learn, from Latin apprehendere, to grasp or seize.
intro.cn: apprentice 经古法语 aprendre（学习）而来，词源是拉丁语 apprehendere（抓住、把握）。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ghend- meant to seize or take hold.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ghend- 意为抓住、握取。

items.en: Apprehendere, ad- plus prehendere, meant to grasp, both with the hand and with the mind.
items.cn: apprehendere 由 ad- 加 prehendere 构成，既指用手抓取，也指用心把握。

items.en: Apprendere became aprendre, to learn; aprendiz meant one who is learning.
items.cn: apprendere 演变为 aprendre（学习）；aprendiz 指正在学习的人。

items.en: English borrowed apprentice for learners bound to masters of trades.
items.cn: 英语十四世纪借入 apprentice，指签约从师的学艺人。

items.en: It now covers trade learners, professional trainees, and any humble beginner.
items.cn: 如今涵盖手艺学徒、行业见习生以及任何生手。

note.en: Apprentice descends from the prehend family of grasping words.
note.cn: apprentice 源自 prehend「抓取」词族。

entries.definition: the period or state of being an apprentice
to arrest someone; to grasp mentally
to grasp fully with the mind
a person being trained for a job
a student working for supervised experience

normalIntro.en: Trace apprentice back to grasping, and every sense follows.
normalIntro.cn: 把 apprentice 追溯到「抓取」，一切义项便顺理成章。

normal.en: apprentice = ap- (toward) + prehend (grasp): one taken in to learn.
normal.cn: apprentice = ap-（朝向）+ prehend（抓取）：被收进来学艺的人。

normal.en: Same root as apprehend, comprehend, prehensile.
The verb pattern: apprentice someone to a master.
normal.cn: 动词句式：apprentice someone to a master（送某人拜师）。

normal.en: Suffix pair: apprentice → apprenticeship, like friend → friendship.

normal.cn: 行会阶梯：学徒、熟练工、师傅。

abstract.en: A small hand gripping a huge hammer — learning starts with holding on.
abstract.cn: 一只小手攥着大锤——学习从握住开始。

abstract.en: A brain with a hand attached: to learn is to grasp twice.
abstract.cn: 长着手的大脑：学习就是两次抓取。

abstract.en: Apprentice sounds like 'a prentice'; just drop the first vowel mentally.
abstract.cn: apprentice 听着像 a prentice，心里去掉首音即可。

examples.en: The apprentice learned the trade in seven hard years.
examples.cn: 学徒在艰苦的七年里学会了这门手艺。

examples.en: She was apprenticed to a master jeweler at fifteen.
examples.cn: 她十五岁就拜在珠宝大师门下当学徒。

examples.en: Even masters once worked as apprentices.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿伦提斯」——阿伦提着工具箱去拜师当学徒，谐音仅助记。

root: 拉丁词根 prehens-/prehend-（抓取、握住）：apprentice 经古法语 aprendre（学习）源自 apprehendere（用手与心去把握），本义「正在把握手艺的人」，即学徒。

sensesIntro.en: From grasping a craft under a master, apprentice extends to professional trainees, unskilled beginners, binding others to learn, learning through service, guild ranks, legal indenture, and figurative discipleship.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「在师傅手下把握手艺」出发，apprentice 延伸到行业见习生、生手、使拜师、在服务中学习、行会等级、契约约束以及比喻性的门徒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a learner's hand gripping the tools under a master's eye
core.cn: 核心意象：学徒的手在师傅注视下握住工具

branches.en: learning a trade or profession under supervision
branches.cn: 在指导下学手艺或学专业

branches.en: beginners and figurative followers in any field
branches.cn: 任何领域的新手与比喻性门徒

branches.en: the two-way bond: being bound and learning by serving
branches.cn: 双向纽带：被收徒与在服务中学习

branches.en: the bottom rung of the guild ladder
the legal paper that holds both sides

intro.en: Apprentice carries the prehend root shared by seize-words and mind-words alike.
intro.cn: apprentice 携带 prehend 词根，抓取类词与心智类词共享此根。

latinIntro.en: Latin prehendere, to seize, is the engine behind apprehend, comprehend, and prehensile.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 prehendere（抓住）是 apprehend、comprehend、prehensile 的动力核心。

items.meaning: to seize; to grasp with the mind

items.example: He comprehended the theory at once.
items.exampleCN: 他立刻领悟了这一理论。
消息让所有人大吃一惊。
